observations.behavior: Replaces a broader host detection with Claude-specific, removing OpenAI transport and generic plugin-discovery support.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes which MCP clients receive the interactive `render-ui` capability; production compatibility is no longer supported.

observations.behavior: Removes an entire method that previously returned true for any OpenAI transport or generic discovery client alongside Claude UI hosts.
observations.posthog_connection: Eliminates the ability to advertise `render-ui` tools to non-Claude clients in both local and production environments.

observations.behavior: Deletes tests asserting that OpenAI transports enable `render-ui`, while retaining only Claude-specific assertions.
observations.posthog_connection: Removes test coverage for the removed behavior rather than preserving compatibility checks.

observations.limitations: The change removes broad compatibility without replacement; documentation and READMEs also remove references to OpenAI and generic discovery. No tier-3 systemic benefit is demonstrated.

review.limitations: The change removes broad compatibility without replacement; documentation and READMEs also remove references to OpenAI and generic discovery. No tier-3 systemic benefit is demonstrated.
review.reason: This is a substantive, bounded correctness and compatibility adjustment: the implementation and its relevant checks are visible, but there is no evidence of broader capability or risk reduction across components.
review.posthog_relevance: Affects PostHog's public-facing MCP tool compatibility and advertised capabilities; could reduce customer support burden if incompatible setups were not working as documented.
review.uncertainty: Changes rely on unverified assumptions about which clients should receive this feature; no migration path or compatibility preservation is shown.
